<STBG 100,0><BGM 0,0,506><TALK 0><NAME 10>In the Tabuladin Isles,
a monster we had never met before

seemed so unlike anything real
that one might take it for a creature
from a desert land's fairy tale...

Its ecology, embedding blue crystal
at its sturdy tail's tip, all mystery.

<CHAR 3,1,7,0,0><TALK 3><NAME 10>...A winged monster that claims the desert
as its territory and is violent enough
to allow no intruders.

That such dangerous monsters lived here
in such numbers across these isles
why had it gone unknown until today!

As one devoted to studying the
Fractured Isles, I can only feel shame...

<STBG 13,1>...But for now, as a monster of ruin,
we must meet it in battle.

Yes, let us stamp the guild's approval
on the hunting request.
<TALK 3><NAME 10><CV 5,19>Now then, explorers, I leave it to you!
